items.stem: Two angles are supplementary. One of the angles measures 65°. What is the measure of the other angle?
items.explanation: Смежные (дополнительные до 180°) углы: 180 − 65 = 115° (C). 25° — дополнение до 90°; 295° — до 360°.

items.stem: Two angles of a triangle measure 50° and 60°. What is the measure, in degrees, of the third angle?
items.explanation: Сумма углов треугольника 180°: 180 − 110 = 70°.

items.stem: Two angles are complementary. One of the angles measures 38°. What is the measure of the other angle?
Two lines intersect, forming a pair of vertical angles. One of the vertical angles measures 72°. What is the measure of the other vertical angle?
items.explanation: Вертикальные углы равны: 72° (B). 108° — смежный угол; 18° — дополнение до 90°.

items.stem: An isosceles triangle has a vertex angle of 40°. What is the measure, in degrees, of each base angle?
items.explanation: Углы при основании равны: (180 − 40)/2 = 70°.

items.stem: What is the measure of each interior angle of an equilateral triangle?
items.explanation: Три равных угла в сумме 180°: по 60° (B).

items.stem: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One of the angles formed measures 110°. Which of the following could be the measure of an angle that forms a same-side interior pair with it?
items.explanation: Односторонние внутренние углы при параллельных прямых в сумме дают 180°: 70° (A). 110° — накрест лежащий или соответственный угол.

items.stem: An exterior angle of a triangle measures 125°. One of the two interior angles not adjacent to it measures 60°. What is the measure, in degrees, of the other nonadjacent interior angle?
items.explanation: Внешний угол равен сумме двух несмежных внутренних: 125 − 60 = 65°.

items.stem: A straight angle is divided into two angles that measure 3x degrees and 2x degrees. What is the value of x?
items.explanation: 5x = 180, x = 36 (B). 72 и 108 — сами углы 2x и 3x; 18 — разделили на 10.

items.stem: In triangle ABC, angle A measures 90° and angle B measures 35°. What is the measure of angle C?
What is the sum, in degrees, of the measures of the interior angles of a quadrilateral?
items.explanation: Сумма углов n-угольника (n − 2) · 180°; для четырёхугольника 360° (два треугольника).

items.stem: Two triangles are similar. The sides of the first triangle are 3, 4, and 5. The shortest side of the second triangle is 9. What is the length of the longest side of the second triangle?
items.explanation: Коэффициент 9/3 = 3, наибольшая сторона 5 · 3 = 15 (C). 12 — средняя сторона; 11 — прибавили 6 к 5; 25 — 5².

items.stem: Two angles that form a linear pair measure x° and 3x°. What is the value of x?
items.explanation: x + 3x = 180, x = 45 (B). 90 — сумма как будто 360/4; 30 и 60 — неверный делитель.

items.stem: The measures of the angles of a triangle are in the ratio 1 : 2 : 3. What is the measure, in degrees, of the largest angle?
items.explanation: Шесть частей по 30°, наибольший угол 3 · 30 = 90°.

items.stem: Two sides of a triangle have lengths 7 and 10. Which of the following could be the length of the third side?
items.explanation: Третья сторона строго между 10 − 7 = 3 и 10 + 7 = 17. Подходит 12 (C); 3 и 17 дают «вырожденный» треугольник, 2 — слишком коротко.

items.stem: The angles of a triangle measure x°, 2x°, and (3x + 30)°. What is the value of x?
items.explanation: 6x + 30 = 180, x = 25 (B). 30 — забыли слагаемое 30; 75 — это угол 3x; 20 — ошибка.

items.stem: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. A pair of alternate interior angles measure (4x + 10)° and (6x − 30)°. What is the value of x?
items.explanation: Накрест лежащие углы равны: 4x + 10 = 6x − 30, 2x = 40, x = 20 (углы по 90°).

items.stem: In triangle ABC, AB = AC and angle B measures 52°. What is the measure of angle A?
items.explanation: AB = AC, поэтому ∠B = ∠C = 52°, ∠A = 180 − 104 = 76° (C). 64° — решили, что 52° — угол при вершине; 128° — 180 − 52.

items.stem: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF, with A corresponding to D, B to E, and C to F. If AB = 6, DE = 15, and BC = 8, what is EF?
items.explanation: Коэффициент 15/6 = 2.5, EF = 8 · 2.5 = 20 (C). 17 — прибавили разность 9; 24 — умножили на 3; 18 — ошибка.

items.stem: What is the measure, in degrees, of each interior angle of a regular hexagon?
items.explanation: Сумма углов шестиугольника 720°, каждый из шести равных — 120°.

items.stem: At the same time of day, a 6-foot-tall person casts a 4-foot shadow and a tree casts a 30-foot shadow. What is the height of the tree, in feet?
items.explanation: Подобные треугольники: высота/тень одинаковы, 6/4 = h/30, h = 45 (C). 20 — перевернули отношение; 32 — прибавили 2; 180 — 6 · 30.

items.stem: Lines ℓ and m are parallel and are cut by a transversal. One angle measures (3y)° and the corresponding angle measures (2y + 24)°. What is the value of y?
items.explanation: Соответственные углы равны: 3y = 2y + 24, y = 24 (B). 72 — сам угол 3y; 48 — 2y; 12 — разделили на 2.

items.stem: Each exterior angle of a regular polygon measures 30°. How many sides does the polygon have?
items.explanation: Внешние углы правильного многоугольника в сумме 360°: 360/30 = 12 сторон.

items.stem: Two angles of a triangle measure 47° and 68°. What is the measure of the exterior angle at the third vertex?
items.explanation: Внешний угол = сумма двух несмежных внутренних: 47 + 68 = 115° (C). 65° — сам третий угол; 133° и 112° — смежные с данными углами.

items.stem: Points A, B, and C lie on a line, with B between A and C. If AB = 2x + 3, BC = x + 5, and AC = 26, what is the length of AB?
items.explanation: AB + BC = AC: 3x + 8 = 26, x = 6, AB = 15 (C). 6 — это x; 11 — BC; 21 — ошибка.

items.stem: In triangle PQR, the measure of angle P is twice the measure of angle Q, and the measure of angle R is 30° more than the measure of angle Q. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle Q?
In triangle ABC, D is the midpoint of AB and E is the midpoint of AC. If BC = 18, what is the length of DE?
items.explanation: Средняя линия треугольника параллельна основанию и равна его половине: 9 (B). 36 — удвоили; 6 — треть.

items.stem: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle XYZ, and the ratio of their corresponding sides is 2 : 5. The perimeter of triangle ABC is 24. What is the perimeter of triangle XYZ?
items.explanation: Периметры относятся как стороны: 24 · 5/2 = 60 (B). 150 — использовали квадрат отношения (как для площадей); 120 — умножили на 5; 48 — на 2.

items.stem: The interior angles of a pentagon measure 100°, 110°, 120°, 95°, and x°. What is the value of x?
items.explanation: Сумма углов пятиугольника (5 − 2) · 180 = 540°. 540 − 425 = 115.

items.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, angle A measures (2x + 8)°, and angle B measures (3x − 3)°. What is the measure of angle A?
In triangle ABC, the bisector of angle A meets side BC at point D. If AB = 12, AC = 8, and BC = 15, what is the length of BD?
items.explanation: Биссектриса делит сторону пропорционально прилежащим сторонам: BD/DC = 12/8, BD = 15 · 12/20 = 9 (C). 7.5 — середина BC; 6 — DC; 10 — ошибка пропорции.

items.stem: In triangle ABC, point D is on AB and point E is on AC so that DE is parallel to BC. If AD = 4, DB = 6, and DE = 5, what is the length of BC?
items.explanation: Треугольники ADE и ABC подобны: AD/AB = DE/BC, 4/10 = 5/BC, BC = 12.5. Частая ошибка — взять DB вместо AB.

items.stem: Two parallel lines are cut by two transversals that intersect at a point P between the parallel lines, forming two triangles that share vertex P. A side from P to the first line has length 6, and the corresponding side from P to the second line has length 9. The side of the first triangle that lies on the first line has length 10. What is the length of the side of the second triangle that lies on the second line?
items.explanation: Треугольники подобны с коэффициентом 9/6 = 1.5, поэтому 10 · 1.5 = 15 (C). 13 — прибавили разность 3; 12 и 16 — ошибки пропорции.

items.stem: The sum of the measures of the interior angles of a polygon is 1,800°. How many sides does the polygon have?
items.explanation: (n − 2) · 180 = 1800, n − 2 = 10, n = 12 (C). 10 — забыли прибавить 2; 11 и 13 — ошибка на единицу.

items.stem: One angle of an isosceles triangle measures 100°. What is the measure, in degrees, of each of the other two angles?
items.explanation: Тупой угол может быть только при вершине (два по 100° не помещаются), остальные (180 − 100)/2 = 40°.

items.stem: In triangle ABC, angle A measures 40°, and the exterior angle at vertex C measures 115°. What is the measure of angle B?
items.explanation: Внешний угол при C равен ∠A + ∠B: ∠B = 115 − 40 = 75° (C). 65° — внутренний угол C; 25° и 140° — ошибки.

items.stem: Triangle ABC has AB = 8, BC = 6, and angle B = 60°. Triangle DEF has DE = 12, EF = 9, and angle E = 60°. Which of the following is true?
choices: The triangles are similar with a scale factor of 3/2.
The triangles are similar with a scale factor of 4/3.
items.explanation: Признак подобия по двум сторонам и углу: 12/8 = 9/6 = 3/2 и углы между ними равны (A). Стороны разные — не равны (B); 4/3 — отношение сторон одного треугольника.

items.stem: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, forming alternate interior angles that measure (x² − 20)° and (x + 10)°, where x > 0. What is the value of x?
In a triangle, the largest angle measures 4 times the smallest angle, and the third angle measures 30° more than the smallest angle. What is the measure of the largest angle?
items.explanation: s + 4s + (s + 30) = 180, s = 25, наибольший 100° (D). 25° — наименьший; 55° — третий угол; 75° — ошибка.

items.stem: In triangle ABC, AB = AC = 10. Point D lies on BC so that AD is perpendicular to BC, and BD = 6. What is the length of AD?
items.explanation: Треугольник ABD прямоугольный: AD = √(10² − 6²) = 8 (C). √136 — сложили квадраты; 4 — 10 − 6.

items.stem: In parallelogram ABCD, angle A measures (3x + 15)° and angle B measures (5x − 35)°. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle A?
items.explanation: Соседние углы параллелограмма в сумме 180°: 8x − 20 = 180, x = 25, ∠A = 90° (это прямоугольник).

items.stem: Triangle PQR has side lengths PQ = 5, QR = 12, and PR = 13. Triangle STU is similar to triangle PQR, and side ST, which corresponds to PQ, has length 7.5. What is the area of triangle STU?
items.explanation: 5-12-13 — прямоугольный, площадь 30. Коэффициент 1.5, площадь растёт в 2.25 раза: 67.5 (C). 45 — умножили площадь на 1.5; 90 и 60 — ошибки.

items.stem: Each interior angle of a regular polygon measures 156°. How many sides does the polygon have?
items.explanation: Внешний угол 180 − 156 = 24°, число сторон 360/24 = 15 (C).

items.stem: In triangle ABC, angle A measures 50° and angle C measures 70°. Point D lies on AC so that BD bisects angle B. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle ADB?
items.explanation: ∠B = 60°, ∠ABD = 30°. В треугольнике ABD: 180 − 50 − 30 = 100°.

items.stem: Two similar triangles have areas of 18 and 50. A side of the smaller triangle has length 6. What is the length of the corresponding side of the larger triangle?
items.explanation: Отношение площадей 50/18 = 25/9 — квадрат отношения сторон 5/3. 6 · 5/3 = 10 (B). 50/3 — умножили на отношение площадей; 25/3 и 12 — ошибки в корне.
